b-atlanta-hawks.2016.licence: non-free logo, as the file page states (fr.wikipedia's non-free content)
b-atlanta-hawks.2016.evidence: en: «On June 24, 2015, the team unveiled ... its updated logos and colors. The new color scheme consisted of Torch Red, Volt Green and Georgia Granite Gray»; the roundel became primary after 2014-15; «On July 21, 2020, the Hawks unveiled new uniforms ... returned to the red, black and yellow color scheme». fr gallery: this file «De 2015 à 2020» (description: from the 2015-16 season), then «Depuis 2020». Today's crest (en File:Atlanta_Hawks_logo.svg) took its current version on 28 Nov 2020 («Update logo», from cdn.nba.com): it reads ATLANTA HAWKS / BASKETBALL in serif letters, deeper red, where this 2015 roundel reads ATLANTA HAWKS / BASKETBALL CLUB in block letters: another lettering, so seasons 2015-16 to 2019-20 get this picture. Sources disagree on the 2020 version: fr's «Depuis 2020» file (from the NBA store) still reads BASKETBALL CLUB; the club's en article shows today's crest, so 2020-21 on stays today's.

Buchstabenanordnung im Austria-Emblem"); the club "darf ... 2 Sterne führen" (24 titles), and today's crest has them, but the earliest picture, the en infobox of 2006-02-05 (this 100 px JPEG, during the Magna years 1999–2008 in which the club played as FK Austria Magna/Memphis Magna, de: name back to FK Austria Wien from 1 July 2008), shows the circle without stars; Commons File:FK_Austria_Wien_logo.svg is labelled the "2013 version". No earlier picture: the en captures of 2004-10-30 and 2005-04-01 and the de capture of 2005-01-25 have none. The starless circle of 2005/06 is placed on 2002/03–2003/04 of the same Magna period, as stars are added, not removed.

f-trabzonspor.2007.evidence: tr.wikipedia Trabzonspor (multi-sport club), «Arma»: Sinan Baykurt's TS crest of 1976-77, then small changes: «92 yılından sonra S harfinin sivrileşmesi, 96 yılından sonra 1967 ibaresinin gelmesi, 2000 yılından sonra 5 şampiyonluğa bir yıldız uygulamasıyla bir yıldız eklenmesi, topun şeklinin ve renginin değişmesi vb. ... en son 2022 yılında resmi olarak güncellenerek en son halini almıştır» (the S sharpened after 1992, 1967 added after 1996, a star after 2000, the ball's shape and colour changed, last officially updated in 2022); the article's gallery «Trabzonspor'un basitçe logo evrimi» (Commons Trabzonspor_Logo_Evrimi.png) dates the corporate logos 1977, 1992, 1996, 2000, 2005, 2013 and 2022. This file's version of 21 May 2021 replaced one of 12 September 2011 (from the club's official site) with «nova versão que carrega a estrela que o clube ostenta» (a version carrying the star the club displays): the crimson crest with the cyan TS swoosh and a large gold star, the drawing the Commons chart gives as the corporate logo of 2005. The 2022 update brought today's dark claret and sky blue (tr.wikipedia's infobox file: «Kulüp, logoyu güncelledi», 20 October 2022), so 2021-22 still wore this crest. Sources differ in detail: the chart draws a browner 2013 shade with a bronze star (a shade of the same claret, the same crest at 64 px), and some files of 2014-2015 copied from en.wikipedia (he, bs) draw the crest without the star; followed the club's tr.wikipedia article (a star from 2000).
f-trabzonspor.2007.verified: crimson shield with a white football at the top right, the cyan TS swoosh, white 1967 at the foot, a large gold star above; today's crest is dark claret and paler blue with a smaller star; 500×500 PNG

w-seattle-reign.2024.title: File:OL_Reign_logo.svg
w-seattle-reign.2024.licence: non-free logo, as the file page states (en.wikipedia's non-free content)
w-seattle-reign.2024.evidence: en.wikipedia Seattle Reign FC, Colors and badge: the 'Historical badges' gallery captions OL_Reign_logo.svg '2020–2023 (primary)'; the team became OL Reign on 6 March 2020 'with ... a new team badge that includes the lion as a symbol for Lyon' and returned to Seattle Reign FC on 9 January 2024 with a modified original crest. Game year 2024 is the NWSL 2023 season (EA FC 24: OL Reign). File uploaded 12 March 2020.

w-sgs-essen.2024.title: File:SGS_Essen_Logo.svg
w-sgs-essen.2024.licence: public domain: below the threshold of originality, as the file page states (trademark rights may apply)
w-sgs-essen.2024.evidence: de.wikipedia SGS Essen: the club's logo since the SG Essen-Schönebeck logo was dropped ('Logo der SG Essen-Schönebeck bis zum Sommer 2012'); this Commons file was extracted from an SGS Essen PDF of the 2022-23 DFB-Pokal quarter-final and uploaded on 30 Nov 2022, and is the infobox logo of de and fifteen other Wikipedias today (Nov 2026); no later logo is named anywhere. en's non-free SGS_Essen_logo.svg (2017) draws the same roundel with the band level.
